title: HOW TO LUCID DREAM TONIGHT! (100% WORKING)

lines.text: Hey hey, dreamers! If you're watching this at three in the morning... perfect. That's the best time.
Tonight you are going to have your first lucid dream. One hundred percent. I promise.
Grab something to write with. Seriously. Write these down. The rules matter.
Rule one. Never look into mirrors. Mirrors in dreams don't work the way you want them to.
Rule two. Don't think about anything scary. The dream listens. Keep it light.
Rule three. Don't tell anyone you're dreaming. They really don't like hearing it.
Rule four. Don't ask dream people about the real world. Especially not lottery numbers. I know. I KNOW. Don't.
Rule five. Don't forcefully change your surroundings. Little things? Fine. Summon a snack. Just don't push the walls around.
Okay! Lie down. Breathe slow. Tell yourself: I will know I'm dreaming.
See you on the other side, dreamers.
